pages.title: Russell Paradox Set
pages.text: The set of all sets that do not contain themselves. If it contains itself, it should not; if it does not, it should. Russell found it and broke naive set theory. In the hand it flickers between being there and being empty, never committing to either.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Cantor Diagonalizer, I fed a Godel Sentence, a Power Set and Paradox Residue together with Chronon Gas. The diagonaliser tried to decide what the set contained and produced this contradiction instead.
